import parse

# Test width/precision with alignment
tests = [
    ("{:.5}", "hello world"),  # Precision 5
    ("{:5}", "hello world"),   # Width 5
    ("{:<5}", "hello world"),  # Left-align width 5
]

for pattern, string in tests:
    p = parse.compile(pattern)
    print(f"Pattern {pattern}: {p._expression}")
    
    r = p.parse(string)
    print(f"parse: {r}")
    
    r2 = p.search(string)
    print(f"search: {r2}")
    print()
PYEOF
